name: Tejas
description: Research in reinforcement learning, model interpretability, and computational imaging.
bio: Hi! I’m Tejas. I enjoy shining light on model internals and working towards safer, more comprehensible machine intelligence.
My current questions center on reinforcement learning and mechanistic interpretability: what a model represents, how those representations change, and which computations shape its behavior.

background.label: Education
background.text: I graduated from Boston University in 2025 with a B.S. in Computer Engineering.

background.label: Current work
background.text: I’m currently working at the Boston University Neurophotonics Center.
